before.requirement: Publish the fourth component of a v line as a dedicated vertex weight.
before.reason: The before parser has no separate weight accumulator. Its output path swaps the vertex vector before using that same vector for vertex_weights, so this capability is absent on the before side.

after.requirement: For a four-component OBJ v line, retain the fourth component as a vertex weight and publish it in the output attributes.
after.reason: The changed helper returns four components when only one value follows xyz. LoadObj appends that value to vertex_weights and transfers the vector to the output attributes. The harness can provide the line as OBJ text before its delimiter.

claims.reason: The dedicated vertex-weight behavior is absent before the change and reachable afterward using the same old harness.
